verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Realtime is WebRTC infrastructure (SFU, TURN, RealtimeKit). The evidence shows no product-native way for users to define background automations that run on their own. The closest items are a single built-in post-meeting AI summary, signed event delivery to your backend, and automatic breakout assignment. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks (webhooks plus Workers), not a configurable automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
